prospective_unqueried_clause_audit.assertion: The 0.7 mg/L bench statistic used daily noon samples, despite hourly logged readings.
prospective_unqueried_clause_audit.fidelity_boundary: Replacing noon with all-hours accuracy is strengthening; omission is coverage loss.

prospective_unqueried_clause_audit.assertion: The greenhouse unit power loss had no assigned nitrate-exposure cause.
prospective_unqueried_clause_audit.fidelity_boundary: No assigned cause is neither nitrate-caused nor proved unrelated to nitrate.

prospective_unqueried_clause_audit.assertion: Film was removed but no before/after comparison establishes an accuracy effect.
prospective_unqueried_clause_audit.fidelity_boundary: Cleaning success does not establish measurement improvement or no effect.

prospective_unqueried_clause_audit.assertion: Gas pockets in two coin cells were included in retention statistics and not classified as a thermal event.
prospective_unqueried_clause_audit.fidelity_boundary: Not classified as a thermal event does not prove handling safety.

prospective_unqueried_clause_audit.assertion: Initial visual yield was 42/50; 48/50 was an earlier estimate.
prospective_unqueried_clause_audit.fidelity_boundary: Do not promote the estimate to observed yield or conflate it with revised strip.

prospective_unqueried_clause_audit.assertion: The 100-cycle pouch test stopped for scheduled fixture replacement, not cell failure.
